prompt:
Vertical 9:16, extremely bright and clean photorealistic beauty portrait shot in a white interior. A fictional adult Japanese woman, aged 23-28. The face is centered and large, in a tight close-up from the top of the head to the upper chest. Shoulders tilted slightly right, neck tilted slightly left, looking directly at the camera. Forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, and chin are all in frame, with hair flowing down to fill the vertical composition.
Glossy long black hair ending below the chest, parted slightly left. Airy see-through bangs on the forehead, delicate strands near the cheeks, and loose waves at the ends. Medium-sized dark brown eyes, natural double eyelids, delicate eyelashes, peach-beige eye makeup, and light coral blush. A natural smile with slightly parted lips showing even upper teeth. Glossy light pink lips. Rounded cheeks, smooth jawline, healthy bright skin. Retain details like pores, fine facial hair, lip lines, and iris details.
Outfit is a soft white to ivory cotton blouse with a round neckline, fine gathers, and small white buttons. No accessories. The background is a very pale gray, a blend of white walls and window light. Soft backlighting from the rear right, with the front of the face illuminated uniformly by a large white reflector. High-key but not overexposed, maintaining the black of the hair and the outline of the pupils.
85-105mm equivalent, f/2.2, eye-level height, focusing primarily on the eyes. No facial perspective distortion; smooth background blur. Balances beauty ad precision with the intimacy of a natural light portrait. No text, logos, watermarks, accessories, flashy nails, extra teeth, mismatched eyes, doll-like skin, or 3DCG effects.

promptZh: 垂直 9:16 比例，在白色室内拍摄的极其明亮、干净且写实的美妆肖像。一位虚构的成年日本女性，年龄设定为 23-28 岁。大脸部构图居中，从头顶到上胸部的紧凑特写。肩膀略微向右倾斜，颈部略微向左，直视镜头。额头、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴和下颌均在画面内，长发垂落在两侧，填满垂直构图。接近黑色的光泽长发，长度延伸至胸部以下，发缝略微偏左。额前有稀疏、轻盈的空气刘海，脸颊旁有几缕精致的发丝，发尾呈自然波浪状。中等大小的深棕色眼睛，自然的双眼皮，精致的上下睫毛，桃米色眼妆，浅珊瑚色腮红。自然的微笑，嘴巴微张，露出整齐的上齿。光泽感的淡粉色嘴唇。圆润的脸颊和流畅的下颌线，健康的亮白肤色。保留毛孔、细小面部绒毛、唇纹和虹膜细节。服装为 白色至象牙色的柔软棉质衬衫，圆领设计，胸前有细褶和白色小纽扣。无配饰。背景并非纯白，而是白色墙壁与窗光融合后的极淡灰色。主体右后方有柔和的逆光，面部正面由大型白色反光板均匀补光。高调风格但不过曝，保留头发的黑色和眼睛轮廓。相当于 85-105mm 镜头，f/2.2 光圈，平视角度，优先对焦于瞳孔。背景平滑虚化，不扭曲面部透视。平衡了美妆广告的精准度与自然光肖像的亲密感。无文字、标志、水印、配饰、夸张的美甲、多余的牙齿、瞳孔不对称、过度放大的眼睛、蜡像感皮肤、浓重的修容、插画感或 3DCG 感。
